column1: # THE OBJECT-HASH COMPARISON (SEPARATE FROM THE SEMANTIC COMPARISON)
# The semantic comparison does NOT require byte-identical objects.
# The G0 C compiler object and the PolyC subject need not be
# byte-identical, and the ACT does not claim they are. Object
# hashes are compared SEPARATELY, and only where exact bytes
# should match: the three PolyC generations G1/G2/G3 compiled from the
# SAME source by the SAME compiler generation must be byte-identical.
# The pairs are ORDERED: each direction is compared separately,
# because the comparator is not assumed to be symmetric.
# The comparator MUST be shown to be SENSITIVE to each dimension
# individually. Altering ONLY the artifact class, ONLY the exit code,
# ONLY the stderr and ONLY the artifact content must each produce
# a COMPARATOR_MISMATCH. A comparator that ignores any dimension
# is INSENSITIVE and its agreement proves nothing.

column3: replace the emitted object with an executable
change a byte inside the emitted object
emit an object for a different architecture
